import java.util.Scanner;

public class Text_Document_Analysis {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);
        String data = input.nextLine();
        input.close();
        
        StringBuilder normal = new StringBuilder();
        StringBuilder parenthetical = new StringBuilder();
        int index = 0;
        int n = data.length();
        
        while (index < n) {
            char c = data.charAt(index);
            if (c == '(') {
                index++;
                StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder();
                while (index < n && data.charAt(index) != ')') {
                    temp.append(data.charAt(index));
                    index++;
                }
                if (index < n) index++; // skip closing parenthesis
                parenthetical.append(temp).append('_');
            } else {
                normal.append(c);
                index++;
            }
        }
        
        int longestOutside = 0, tempCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < normal.length(); i++) {
            char c = normal.charAt(i);
            if (c == '_') {
                if (tempCount > longestOutside) longestOutside = tempCount;
                tempCount = 0;
            } else if (Character.isLetter(c)) {
                tempCount++;
            }
        }
        if (tempCount > longestOutside) longestOutside = tempCount;
        
        int parentheticalWords = 0, tempParen = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < parenthetical.length(); j++) {
            char c = parenthetical.charAt(j);
            if (c == '_') {
                if (tempParen > 0) parentheticalWords++;
                tempParen = 0;
            } else if (Character.isLetter(c)) {
                tempParen++;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(longestOutside + " " + parentheticalWords);
    }
}
